title: CS50's Introduction to Computer Science
description: Harvard University's introductory course on computer science and programming. It covers algorithms, data structures, memory, web development and databases using C, Python, SQL and JavaScript.
descriptionAr: كورس تمهيدي من جامعة هارفارد في علوم الحاسب والبرمجة. يغطي الخوارزميات وهياكل البيانات والذاكرة وتطوير الويب وقواعد البيانات باستخدام C وPython وSQL وJavaScript.
whatYouLearn: Program in C, Python, SQL and JavaScript

title: CS50's Introduction to Programming with Python
description: A beginner-friendly course from Harvard on programming with Python. It covers functions, conditionals, loops, exceptions, libraries, unit tests, file I/O and regular expressions.

title: The Odin Project: Foundations
description: A free, project-based path into web development. The Foundations course teaches Git, the command line, HTML, CSS and JavaScript basics by building real pages.
whatYouLearn: Use Git and the command line
Build pages with HTML and CSS
